Mathematical models in mechanics
Mathematical models in mechanics

The basic ideas of mathematical modelling as applied in Mechanics. Students should be familiar with the terms: particle, lamina, rigid body, rod (light, uniform, non-uniform), inextensible string, smooth and rough surface, light smooth pulley, bead, wire, peg. Students should be familiar with the assumptions made in using these models.

Kinematics of a particle moving in a straight line

Motion in a straight line with constant acceleration. Graphical solutions may be required, including displacement-time, velocity-time, speed-time and acceleration-time graphs. Knowledge and use of formulae for constant acceleration will be required.
